inventory_note: the six plural rows below are the high-frequency core, NOT a closed inventory; a surface that matches none of them is unclassified here, not ill-formed
repair_of: unit-v1.json (no weak-realization gate: a literal, uncontracted weak radical in a hollow-root singular false-passed a plural template as though the root were sound; Sol round-3-style repair, ported from inc-derivatives/unit-v4.json's weak_realization_gate)

rules.text: a plural template matches only against SUPPLIED root radicals filling R1..R3 in order; the consumer never derives a root and never coins a plural
the singular's own template is a PRIOR, not a rule: the attested plural is a lexical fact, so this unit classifies an observed surface and never predicts one
a suffixal (sound) plural is outside this inventory; zero surviving templates -> abstain no_template rather than forcing a restructured reading
where a plural template is letter-identical to a singular template the pack declares BOTH rows, so the honest verdict on that skeleton is abstain ambiguous_template
a lexeme with more than one attested plural yields more than one classified surface; this unit never ranks them and never emits one as the plural
concord follows the referent's rationality, not the plural's template; this unit emits no concord claim

every realization of a weak radical (و، ي) is licensed per template, slot and radical by weak_realizations.by_template: an altered letter must appear in that entry's substituted list, and a weak radical may stand literally only where literal_licensed is true; nothing is licensed by default — an uncontracted hollow/weak singular does not by itself license a restructured-plural classification

every weak radical of the matched template requires the exact bound declaration (weak_position + weak_radical) -> otherwise weak_declaration_unbound; an unlicensed realization -> weak_realization_unlicensed; a declared weak position/radical the supplied radicals do not bear -> weak_declaration_contradicts_root
